# Differential Expression Analysis
## Volcano for DE_EC
```{r Volcano_DE_EC}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("/Users/hueee/Lab/Feinberg Lab/Single_cell_adipose_tissue"))
DE_EC<- read.csv("../DE_EC/results/2024-06-30/Endothelial Cell-HFSC_vs_Endothelial Cell-Chow/DE_results_Endothelial Cell-HFSC_vs_Endothelial Cell-Chow.csv")
head(DE_EC) #gene p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2 p_val_adj
colnames(DE_EC)[1:3] <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
rownames(DE_EC) <- DE_EC$Gene
head(DE_EC)
x <- DE_EC

logFCcut <- 1 #log2-foldchange
pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.1 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2 
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2 <- 1e-10
pvalCut3 <- 1e-20

#置x，y軸的最大最小位置
xmin <- (range(x$logFC)[1]- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ 10))
xmax <- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ (10-range(x$logFC)[1]))
ymin <- 0
ymax <- -log10(x$P.Value)[3] * 1.1

# 基因名的颜色，需大于等于pathway的数量，这里自定义了足够多的颜色
mycol <- c("darkgreen","chocolate4","blueviolet","#223D6C","#D20A13","#088247","#58CDD9","#7A142C","#5D90BA","#431A3D","#91612D","#6E568C","#E0367A","#D8D155","#64495D","#7CC767")

# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#FB9A99"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#B2DF8A"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#329E3F"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"
color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)
x$color_transparent <- color_transparent

# 複雜的的setting for size
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
size <- rep(1, n1)

#不同阈值的点的大小
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC > logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3]<- 6

# Construct the plot object
#BiocManager::install('ggthemes')
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(gridExtra)
p1 <- ggplot(data=x, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), label = Gene, color = pathway)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +

  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"), y=bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")), title="") + 
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, -2,-logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, -2, -logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2 , 5),
    limits = c(-10, 10) #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看
  ) +
  #或用下面这行：
  #xlim(c(xmin, xmax)) + 

#画阈值分界线
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) + #虚线的形状和粗细
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  
theme_bw(base_size = 10#, base_family = "Times" #修改字体
         ) +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

p1 <- p1 + 
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40", 
             linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1)

# 显示 logFC > n 的基因的基因名
n = 2
p1 + geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC,
                         y = -log10(P.Value),
                         label = ifelse(logFC > n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")),
                     colour="#9c0917", size = 3, box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
                     point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, 
                      y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC < -n & -log10(P.Value) > 10, rownames(x),"")),
                  colour="#0054a3", size = 3, box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"), 
                  point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines"))
ggsave("../DE_EC/DE_EC_volcano.pdf", width=6,height=6)
ggsave("../DE_EC/DE_EC_volcano.png", width=6,height=6)
```

## Bubble for DE_EC_top
```{r Bubble_EC_top}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
data <- DE_EC
data_up <- subset(data,logFC>0)[1:20,1:6]
data_down <- subset(data,logFC<0)[1:20,1:6]
data_top20 <- rbind(data_up,data_down)
data_top20 <- arrange(data_top20,logFC,decrease =T)
data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value > 0])/100
# data_top20 <- data_top20[order(data_top20$logFC, decreasing = F),]
# min_nonzero_value <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value != 0])
# data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min_nonzero_value * 1e-2

# Convert Symbol to a factor to control the order of plotting 
data_top20$Gene <- factor(data_top20$Gene, levels = unique(data_top20$Gene))

# Map shapes and colors based on LogFC
data_top20$Shape <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, 24, 25) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data_top20$Color <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "#DA7680", "#72A7D9")
data_top20$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down"))
# Plot
ggplot(data_top20, aes(x=logFC, y=Gene, size=-log10(P.Value), shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color="black",face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top20 Up- & Down-regulated Genes in ECs",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P.Value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, 0, 5),
    limits = c(-5.5, 5.5)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17))) 

# Save the plot
ggsave("../DE_EC/DE_EC_top20_logFC.pdf", width=5, height=8)
ggsave("../DE_EC/DE_EC_top20_logFC.png", width=5, height=8,dpi = 600)
```

# EC Functional Analysis
## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_cano}
library(readxl)
data <- read_excel("../DE_EC/IPA_canonical.xlsx")
colnames(data) <- c("Ingenuity Canonical Pathways","-log(p-value)","zScore","Ratio","Molecules","Counts")
data <- data[order(data$`-log(p-value)`, decreasing = TRUE),][1:20,]
data <- data[order(data$zScore, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
# 构建一个防通路名太长的函数
label_wrap <- function(label, width) {
  sapply(label, function(x) {
    words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    lines <- ""
    current_line <- ""
    for (word in words) {
      if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(word) + 1 > width) {
        lines <- paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
        current_line <- word
      } else {
        if (current_line == "") {
          current_line <- word
        } else {
          current_line <- paste(current_line, word)
        }
      }
    }
    paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
  })
}

ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Up- & Down-regulated Canonical Pathways in ECs",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 50))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
ggsave("../DE_EC/Cano_top20.pdf", width=7, height=6)
```

## Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord}
data <- read_excel("../DE_EC/IPA_canonical_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- DE_EC
#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data[1:8,],!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#ffd580","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478","#0078ab")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'),
        limit = c(1,0),
        title = "Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin Endothelial Cells after 24-week HFSC Diet") 
#ggsave("../DE_EC/IPA_canonical_chord1.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.25)
```

```{r Volcano_DE_MEC}
head(DE_MEC)

pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.1 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2
```

# Differential Expression Analysis
## volcano & bubble plots (loop)
```{r EC_DE_volcano_bubble_loop}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------
cell_types <- c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC", "LEC")
date_dir <- "2024-07-01"
de_dir   <- file.path("../subset_EC/results", date_dir)
out_dir  <- file.path("../subset_EC/plots",   date_dir)
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Volcano thresholds (consistent with your template)
logFCcut  <- 1
pvalCut   <- 1e-2

logFCcut2 <- 2
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2  <- 1e-10
pvalCut3  <- 1e-20

# Axis control
x_buffer <- 0.5         # avoid points sticking to border
robust_q <- 0.99        # robust quantile for symmetric x-limit (0.99 or 0.995 both reasonable)
min_xlim <- logFCcut2   # ensure at least covers ±logFCcut2 lines

# -----------------------------
# Helper: robust symmetric x-limit
# -----------------------------
robust_symmetric_xlim <- function(logfc, q = 0.99, buffer = 0.5, min_limit = 2) {
  logfc <- logfc[is.finite(logfc)]
  if (length(logfc) == 0) return(c(-min_limit, min_limit))

  abs_fc <- abs(logfc)

  # Robust scale: q-th quantile of |logFC|
  qv <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(abs_fc, probs = q, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))

  # Fallback for small vectors (quantile can be unstable if N is tiny)
  if (!is.finite(qv) || length(abs_fc) < 50) {
    qv <- max(abs_fc, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Final symmetric limit (must cover at least min_limit)
  lim <- max(qv, min_limit, na.rm = TRUE)
  lim <- ceiling(lim + buffer)

  c(-lim, lim)
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: Volcano plot function
# -----------------------------
make_volcano <- function(x, title_text = "") {

  # X-axis: symmetric, include ALL points
  logfc <- x$logFC
  logfc <- logfc[is.finite(logfc)]
  xmax_abs <- max(abs(logfc), na.rm = TRUE)
  xmax_abs <- max(xmax_abs, min_xlim)          # ensure threshold lines fit
  xmax_abs <- ceiling(xmax_abs + x_buffer)

  # Y-axis: include ALL points (avoid Inf from P=0)
  pvals <- x$P.Value
  pvals <- pvals[is.finite(pvals) & pvals > 0]
  logp <- -log10(pvals)

  ymin <- 0
  ymax <- if (length(logp) > 0) max(logp, na.rm = TRUE) else 10
  # ensure horizontal threshold lines fit
  ymax <- max(ymax, -log10(pvalCut), -log10(pvalCut2))
  ymax <- ceiling(ymax * 1.05)

  # Color mapping
  n1 <- nrow(x)
  cols <- rep("grey", n1)
  names(cols) <- rownames(x)

  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- "#f77e7e"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- "#c21b2b"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- "#73b6f5"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- "#136cbf"

  x$color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)

  # Size mapping
  size <- rep(1, n1)
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- 2
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- 4
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC >  logFCcut3] <- 6
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- 2
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- 4
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3] <- 6

  # Plot (IMPORTANT: use coord_cartesian so points are never dropped)
  p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +
    labs(
      x = bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"),
      y = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
      title = title_text
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2),
               color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-xmax_abs, xmax_abs),
      ylim = c(ymin, ymax)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  # Labels
  n_label <- 2
  p <- p +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = ifelse(logFC >  n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 5, Gene, "")),
      colour = "#9c0917", size = 3,
      box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = ifelse(logFC < -n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 5, Gene, "")),
      colour = "#0054a3", size = 3,
      box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
    )

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Select a relaxed significant set for bubble plot if too few genes pass cutoff
# -----------------------------
select_sig_for_bubble <- function(de2,
                                  cutoffs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1),
                                  n_target_each = 20) {
  # de2 columns required: ID, P.value, LogFC, adjP.Value

  for (c in cutoffs) {
    x_sig <- de2[de2$adjP.Value <= c, , drop = FALSE]
    n_up <- sum(x_sig$LogFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_dn <- sum(x_sig$LogFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (n_up >= n_target_each && n_dn >= n_target_each) {
      return(list(data = x_sig, cutoff_used = c, source = "adjP_filter"))
    }
  }

  # Fallback: use all genes to guarantee enough candidates for 20/20
  return(list(data = de2, cutoff_used = NA, source = "all_genes"))
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: Bubble plot function
# -----------------------------
make_bubble <- function(x_in, title_text = "", n_each = 20) {

  if (nrow(x_in) < 2) return(NULL)

  up <- x_in[x_in$LogFC > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  dn <- x_in[x_in$LogFC < 0, , drop = FALSE]

  # If one side is completely missing, bubble is not meaningful
  if (nrow(up) < 1 || nrow(dn) < 1) return(NULL)

  # Up: largest positive LogFC; Down: most negative LogFC
  up <- up[order(up$LogFC, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  dn <- dn[order(dn$LogFC, decreasing = FALSE), , drop = FALSE]

  up <- head(up, n_each)
  dn <- head(dn, n_each)

  data <- rbind(dn, up)

  # Keep plotting order (down -> up)
  data <- data[order(data$LogFC, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  data$ID <- factor(data$ID, levels = rev(data$ID))

  data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$LogFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                            levels = c("Up", "Down"))

  xmax_abs <- max(abs(data$LogFC), na.rm = TRUE)
  xmax_abs <- ceiling(xmax_abs + 0.5)

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = LogFC, y = ID,
                        size = -log10(P.value),
                        shape = Regulation,
                        color = Regulation)) +
    geom_point(stroke = 1) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-xmax_abs, xmax_abs)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgrey", size = 0.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      size  = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
      x     = "LogFC",
      y     = "Gene Symbol",
      color = "Gene Regulation",
      shape = "Gene Regulation"
    ) +
    guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Loop
# -----------------------------
for (ct in cell_types) {

  message("Processing ", ct)

  de_file <- file.path(de_dir, paste0("DE_results_", ct, "-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(de_file)) {
    message("  Skipping: DE file not found: ", de_file)
    next
  }

  de <- read.csv(de_file)

  # Standardize colnames (your sample had an indexing bug; fix it scientifically)
  colnames(de)[1:6] <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
  rownames(de) <- de$Gene

  # Bubble table (mimic your xlsx format but directly from csv)
  de2 <- de %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, P.Value, logFC, adjP.Value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(ID = Gene, P.value = P.Value, LogFC = logFC)

  # Bubble: progressively relax adjP cutoff to ensure 20 Up + 20 Down
  bubble_pick <- select_sig_for_bubble(de2,
                                       cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1),   # EC 默认从 0.05 开始更合理
                                       n_target_each = 20
                                       )

  de2_for_bubble <- bubble_pick$data
  
  # Volcano
  p_vol <- make_volcano(de, title_text = paste0(ct, ": HFSC vs Chow"))
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_volcano.pdf")), p_vol, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_volcano.png")), p_vol, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 500)

  # Bubble
  p_bub <- make_bubble(de2_for_bubble, title_text = paste0("Significant DEGs in ", ct, ": HFSC vs Chow"), n_each = 20)
  if (!is.null(p_bub)) {
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_bubble.pdf")), p_bub, width = 5, height = 7, dpi = 600)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_bubble.png")), p_bub, width = 5, height = 7, dpi = 600)
  } else {
    message("  Bubble skipped (no significant genes).")
  }
}
```

## Functional Analysis
```{r label_wrap}
# 构建一个防通路名太长的函数
label_wrap <- function(label, width) {
  sapply(label, function(x) {
    words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    lines <- ""
    current_line <- ""
    for (word in words) {
      if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(word) + 1 > width) {
        lines <- paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
        current_line <- word
      } else {
        if (current_line == "") {
          current_line <- word
        } else {
          current_line <- paste(current_line, word)
        }
      }
    }
    paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
  })
}
```

### Cano_ChordPlot
```{r cano_chord_loop}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(Hmisc)

# ========= 参数区 =========
base_dir <- "../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01"
ipa_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "IPA")

groups <- c("REC", "MesEC", "VEC", "MbEC", "LEC")

# 你的基因名映射规则（保持和原来一致）
fix_gene_names <- function(ind) {
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fyb1","Fyb",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqa1","H2-Aa",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqb1","H2-Ab1",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Drb5","H2-Eb1",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz2", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)
  ind
}

# 颜色（8 pathways）
mycol <- c("#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070",
           "#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF")
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol, 0.9)

# ========= 主循环 =========
for (grp in groups) {

  message("Processing: ", grp)

  chord_xlsx <- file.path(ipa_dir, paste0(grp, "_chord_input.xlsx"))
  de_csv     <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("DE_results_", grp, "-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv"))
  out_pdf    <- file.path(ipa_dir, paste0("IPA_", grp, "_chord.pdf"))

  # --- 读文件（加一点健壮性检查） ---
  if (!file.exists(chord_xlsx)) {
    warning("Missing chord input: ", chord_xlsx, " (skipped)")
    next
  }
  if (!file.exists(de_csv)) {
    warning("Missing DE file: ", de_csv, " (skipped)")
    next
  }

  data <- read_excel(chord_xlsx)
  colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"

  expr <- read.csv(de_csv)
  colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
  expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
  row.names(expr) <- expr$gene

  # --- 长表转边表 ---
  dt <- pivot_longer(
    data,
    !Pathway,
    names_to = "index",
    values_to = "gene",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

  # 统一基因名格式（保持你原来的逻辑）
  dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)

  dt$value <- 1
  edge <- dt[-2]
  edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = unique(edge$Pathway))

  # --- 宽矩阵 ---
  mat <- acast(edge, gene ~ Pathway)
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  # --- 对齐 DE 表的 gene 名 ---
  ind <- row.names(mat)
  ind <- fix_gene_names(ind)

  # 处理 ind 不在 expr 的情况（避免 NA 报错）
  miss <- setdiff(ind, rownames(expr))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    warning(grp, ": ", length(miss), " genes not found in DE table. They will be dropped.")
  }
  ind_keep <- intersect(ind, rownames(expr))

  # 若全部丢光，直接跳过
  if (length(ind_keep) == 0) {
    warning(grp, ": no genes matched between chord matrix and DE table (skipped).")
    next
  }

  # --- 构建 mat2（GOChord 输入）---
  # 注意：mat 的 rownames 是 dt$gene（Title case），而 ind_keep 是经过映射后的名字（用于取 logFC）
  # 为了让 mat2 行名能对应到 expr 的 gene，我们用 ind_keep 作为最终行名
  mat_sub <- mat[match(gsub(" ", "", rownames(mat)), gsub(" ", "", rownames(mat))), , drop = FALSE]  # 保持原行顺序
  # 更稳：直接按 ind_keep 重新筛选 mat 的行（需要把 mat 行名也做同样映射后再匹配）
  mat_rn_fixed <- fix_gene_names(row.names(mat))
  mat_sub <- mat[mat_rn_fixed %in% ind_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat_sub) <- mat_rn_fixed[mat_rn_fixed %in% ind_keep]  # 用 DE 表 gene 作为行名

  logFC <- expr[rownames(mat_sub), "logFC"]
  ID    <- rownames(mat_sub)

  mat2 <- data.frame(mat_sub, ID = ID, logFC = logFC)
  rownames(mat2) <- mat2$ID
  mat2 <- mat2 %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

  # --- 出图并保存（对每个 grp 单独写文件）---
  p <- GOChord(
  mat2,
  space = 0.02,
  gene.size = 3,
  process.label = 10,
  border.size = 0,
  ribbon.col = mycol1,
  gene.order = "logFC",
  lfc.col = c("#de2128","white","#02a858"),
  title = paste0("Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin ", grp, " after 24-week HFSC Diet")
)

ggsave(
  filename = out_pdf,
  plot = p,
  width = 8, height = 9.72,
)
}
```

### MbEC
```{r MbEC_chord}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(Hmisc)

# ========= 参数 =========
base_dir <- "../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01"
ipa_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "IPA")
grp <- "MbEC"
top_n <- 60

# ========= 基因映射函数 =========
fix_gene_names <- function(ind) {
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fyb1","Fyb",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqa1","H2-Aa",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqb1","H2-Ab1",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Hla-Drb5","H2-Eb1",ind)
  ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz2", ind)
  ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)
  ind
}

# ========= 文件路径 =========
chord_xlsx <- file.path(ipa_dir, paste0(grp, "_chord_input.xlsx"))
de_csv     <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("DE_results_", grp, "-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv"))
out_pdf    <- file.path(ipa_dir, paste0("IPA_", grp, "_chord_top20.pdf"))

# ========= 读数据 =========
data <- read_excel(chord_xlsx)
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"

expr <- read.csv(de_csv)
colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
expr <- as.data.frame(expr)
rownames(expr) <- expr$gene

# ========= 长表转边表 =========
dt <- pivot_longer(
  data,
  !Pathway,
  names_to = "index",
  values_to = "gene",
  values_drop_na = TRUE
)

dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
dt$value <- 1

edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = unique(edge$Pathway))

# ========= 构建宽矩阵 =========
mat <- acast(edge, gene ~ Pathway)
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

# ========= 对齐基因名 =========
ind <- row.names(mat)
ind <- fix_gene_names(ind)

ind_keep <- intersect(ind, rownames(expr))
if (length(ind_keep) < 2) {
  stop("Too few genes matched between chord matrix and DE table.")
}

mat_rn_fixed <- fix_gene_names(row.names(mat))
mat_sub <- mat[mat_rn_fixed %in% ind_keep, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat_sub) <- mat_rn_fixed[mat_rn_fixed %in% ind_keep]

logFC <- expr[rownames(mat_sub), "logFC"]

# ========= 构建 mat2 =========
mat2 <- data.frame(mat_sub, logFC = logFC)

# ========= 关键步骤：取 Top20 =========
mat2 <- mat2[is.finite(mat2$logFC), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[order(abs(mat2$logFC), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[1:min(top_n, nrow(mat2)), , drop = FALSE]

# ========= 清理 pathway 列 =========
path_cols <- setdiff(colnames(mat2), "logFC")

if (length(path_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No pathway columns found after filtering.")
}

# 去掉全0列
keep_path <- colSums(as.matrix(mat2[, path_cols, drop = FALSE]) > 0) > 0
mat2 <- mat2[, c(path_cols[keep_path], "logFC"), drop = FALSE]

# 再次安全检查
if (nrow(mat2) < 2 || sum(as.matrix(mat2[, setdiff(colnames(mat2),"logFC"), drop = FALSE]) > 0) < 2) {
  stop("Not enough gene-pathway edges after Top20 filtering.")
}

# ========= 颜色 =========
mycol <- c("#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070",
           "#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF")
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol, 0.9)

# ========= 作图 =========
p <- GOChord(
  mat2,
  space = 0.02,
  gene.size = 3,
  process.label = 10,
  border.size = 0,
  ribbon.col = mycol1,
  gene.order = "logFC",
  lfc.col = c("#de2128","white","#02a858"),
  title = paste0("Genes Significantly Impacting Pathways \nin ", 
                 grp, " after 24-week HFSC Diet")
)

ggsave(filename = out_pdf, plot = p, width = 8, height = 9.72)

message("Saved: ", out_pdf)
```

```{r bubble_IREC}
data <- read.csv("../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/DE_results_IREC-HFSC_vs_Chow_sig05.csv")

down_top10 <- head(filtered[filtered$LogFC < 0, ][order(filtered$LogFC[filtered$LogFC < 0]), ], 10)

# Map shapes and colors based on LogFC
```

## volcano
```{r LEC_volcano_only}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# -----------------------------
# Input
# -----------------------------
de_file <- "../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/DE_results_LEC-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv"
x <- read.csv(de_file)

# Standardize column names
colnames(x)[1:6] <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
rownames(x) <- x$Gene

# Avoid Inf from P.Value == 0
x$P.Value <- as.numeric(x$P.Value)
x$P.Value[x$P.Value == 0] <- .Machine$double.xmin

# -----------------------------
# Thresholds (same style as your pipeline)
# -----------------------------
logFCcut  <- 1
pvalCut   <- 1e-2

logFCcut2 <- 2
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2  <- 1e-10
pvalCut3  <- 1e-20

x_buffer <- 0.5

# -----------------------------
# Dynamic axes (include ALL points)
# -----------------------------
# Symmetric x-axis
logfc <- x$logFC[is.finite(x$logFC)]
xmax_abs <- max(abs(logfc), na.rm = TRUE)
xmax_abs <- max(xmax_abs, logFCcut2)          # ensure cutoff2 lines are inside
xmax_abs <- ceiling(xmax_abs + x_buffer)

# y-axis from data ONLY (do NOT force pvalCut2)
logp <- -log10(x$P.Value)
logp <- logp[is.finite(logp)]
ymin <- 0
ymax <- if (length(logp) > 0) max(logp, na.rm = TRUE) else 10
# Always keep main threshold visible
ymax <- max(ymax, -log10(pvalCut))
ymax <- ceiling(ymax * 1.05)

# Only draw pvalCut2 line if it is relevant
has_pvalCut2 <- any(x$P.Value < pvalCut2, na.rm = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# Color + size mapping (your original scheme)
# -----------------------------
n1 <- nrow(x)
cols <- rep("grey", n1)

cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- "#136cbf"

x$color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)

size <- rep(1, n1)
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC >  logFCcut3] <- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3] <- 6

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +
  labs(
    x = bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"),
    y = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
    title = "LEC: HFSC vs Chow"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut),
             color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut),
             color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2),
             color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-xmax_abs, xmax_abs),
                  ylim = c(ymin, ymax)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# Add pvalCut2 line only if needed
if (has_pvalCut2) {
  p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2),
                      color = "grey40", linetype = "longdash", lwd = 0.1)
}

# Label
n_label <- 1
p <- p +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(logFC >  n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 3, Gene, "")),
    colour = "#9c0917", size = 3,
    box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = ifelse(logFC < -n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 3, Gene, "")),
    colour = "#0054a3", size = 3,
    box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
  )

# Save
out_png <- "../subset_EC/plots/2024-07-01/DE_LEC_volcano2.png"
out_pdf <- "../subset_EC/plots/2024-07-01/DE_LEC_volcano2.pdf"

ggsave(out_png, plot = p, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 500)
ggsave(out_pdf, plot = p, width = 6, height = 6)
```

# Canonical pathway bubble plots
```{r label_wrap}
# 构建一个防通路名太长的函数
label_wrap <- function(label, width) {
  sapply(label, function(x) {
    words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    lines <- ""
    current_line <- ""
    for (word in words) {
      if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(word) + 1 > width) {
        lines <- paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
        current_line <- word
      } else {
        if (current_line == "") {
          current_line <- word
        } else {
          current_line <- paste(current_line, word)
        }
      }
    }
    paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
  })
}
```

```{r IPA_cano_celltype_bubble, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

infile <- "../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/IPA/selected_pathway_celltype_top20.xlsx"   # 你的输出 xlsx
outdir <- "../subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/IPA/IPA_bubble_by_celltype"                # 输出文件夹
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 获取所有 sheet 名
sheets <- excel_sheets(infile)
sheets <- sheets[!toupper(sheets) %in% c("ALL_TOP")]   # 跳过汇总sheet

for (sh in sheets) {

  data <- read_excel(infile, sheet = sh)

  # ---- 兼容列名：找 pathway / -logp / zScore / Ratio ----
  path_col <- if ("Ingenuity Canonical Pathways" %in% colnames(data)) {
    "Ingenuity Canonical Pathways"
  } else if ("Canonical Pathways" %in% colnames(data)) {
    "Canonical Pathways"
  } else if ("Pathway" %in% colnames(data)) {
    "Pathway"
  } else {
    # 兜底：通常第一列是 pathway 名
    colnames(data)[1]
  }

  logp_col <- if ("minusLogP__for_sort" %in% colnames(data)) {
    "minusLogP__for_sort"
  } else if ("-log(p-value)" %in% colnames(data)) {
    "-log(p-value)"
  } else {
    # 兜底：第二列是 -log(p-value)（你前面定义过）
    colnames(data)[2]
  }

  z_col <- if ("zScore" %in% colnames(data)) "zScore" else "z score"
  ratio_col <- if ("Ratio" %in% colnames(data)) "Ratio" else NA

  # ---- 整理数据 ----
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Pathway = .data[[path_col]],
      zScore = as.numeric(.data[[z_col]]),
      minusLogP = as.numeric(.data[[logp_col]]),
      Regulation = factor(ifelse(zScore > 0, "Up",
                                 ifelse(zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down", "NA"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(zScore)  # 用于 y 轴排序（你也可以改成 arrange(minusLogP)）

  # y轴顺序：按 zScore 从小到大（你原来是按 zScore 排序）
  data$Pathway <- factor(data$Pathway, levels = data$Pathway)

  # size：优先 Ratio*100；没有 Ratio 就用 abs(zScore)
  if (!is.na(ratio_col)) {
    data <- data %>% mutate(SizeVal = as.numeric(.data[[ratio_col]]) * 100)
    size_lab <- "Ratio (%)"
  } else {
    data <- data %>% mutate(SizeVal = abs(zScore))
    size_lab <- "|Z-score|"
  }

  # ---- 画图（每个 celltype 一张）----
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(
    x = zScore,
    y = Pathway,
    size = SizeVal,
    shape = Regulation,
    color = minusLogP
  )) +
    geom_point(stroke = 1) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF", high = "#FEDD94") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "lightgrey", size = 0.2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Significant Canonical Pathways in ", sh, "s: HFSC vs Chow"),
      size = size_lab,
      x = "Z-score",
      y = "Canonical Pathways",
      color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
      shape = "Regulation"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$Pathway), width = 47)) +
    guides(
      size  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 24)),
      shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
      )

  # ---- 保存 ----
  out_pdf <- file.path(outdir, paste0("Cano_", sh, "_top20.pdf"))
  ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 7, height = 6)
  #out_png <- file.path(outdir, paste0("Cano_", sh, "_top20.png"))
  #ggsave(out_png, p, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```
